firmware.Notes: v3.1.0 standalone official release. Design-system dashboard (Paper/Tide modes with toggle), CSS extracted to LittleFS, admin "Web server is off" recovery page with Turn-on button, WiFi error message SSID fallback (no more empty quotes), data-source attribution footer with CAMS verbatim clause, help.html canonical Data Sources section. Includes Driftwood firmware Build 104-108 changes (alert-page pagination fix, severe-warning takeover state machine, TEST ONLY banner, per-warning confirmation gate) for the Driftwood variant. Built from Build 110, commit b5c5b98.
